Priya (Support): Escalation incoming — Helio Labs (tenant: helio-trial-11) can't complete onboarding. Bulk ingest job returns 504s for /v1/embeddings. They have a customer-facing demo tomorrow; renewal check-in in 4 days. Need CS ownership and an immediate mitigation + comms plan. :rotating_light:
Sam (CS): Assigning to CS P1. @Hana can you triage whether this is infra or client payload? I'll jump on a quick triage call with Support and the customer if needed.
Priya (Support): Error excerpt: ```
{"status":504, "error":"gateway_timeout", "request_id":"r_9f8e7c"}
Trace: request -> embed-proxy -> edge-cache -> timeout
```
Priya (Support): Note: we also see a spike in request latency from their IP block and a burst of parallel jobs from their CI pipeline.
Hana (Eng): Initial read: edge cache eviction under heavy concurrent prefix writes. Short-term options: (A) throttle parallel ingest from tenant, (B) move tenant to a less-loaded pool, (C) increase per-tenant ingest concurrency cap. I can flip pool routing now. Command: `redwoodctl tenant route helio-trial-11 --pool=eu-west-lowload`
Luis (AM): Demo is scheduled for 10:00 CET tomorrow. If not fixed, this could push renewal timeline. Customer mentioned potential multi-workflow purchase pending demo success. I'll join any customer call.
Sam (CS): Proposed comms plan: 1) Immediate: 15-min triage call with Support+Eng now and a 30-min remediation session booked with the customer within the hour. 2) If mitigated, send remediation summary + offer $750 account credit and 1-week trial extension. 3) Update renewal playbook and flag for proactive outreach in 3 days. Luis, ok on credit/extension? :memo:
Luis (AM): OK to approve $750 credit + 1-week extension. Please use this exact phrasing: "We apologize for the disruption. We've applied a temporary mitigation, and as a gesture we're crediting $750 to your account and extending your trial by 1 week." Approve. :+1:
Priya (Support): Reached out to customer; they can do a call in 35 minutes. They provided SSO admin contact and a sample ingest manifest. Attaching sample here.
Hana (Eng): I've moved helio-trial-11 to eu-west-lowload and applied a temporary concurrency cap. Observability shows errors plunging. I'll keep the route for 3 hours and follow up with a PR to add a debounce on prefix writes.
OpsBot: Incident created #INC-2033-900; severity=high; assignees=Sam (CS), Hana (Eng); created_at=1757777785
Sam (CS): Action items for CS: - Lead remediation call and validate demo path - Draft remediation email with credit language and trial extension - Deliver SSO enablement notes + tailored ingest script within 6 hours - Update CRM case and renewal playbook (flag: high risk)
Priya (Support): Customer wants a sample ingest script in Python and Node. I'll gather their manifest and forward.
Hana (Eng): Follow-ups: submit batching/debounce PR, add rate-limiter fallback for heavy prefix write patterns, and schedule a controlled revert after 24h of stability.
Sam (CS): Call complete 10/10: workaround validated by customer, demo flows exercised end-to-end. Customer appreciated rapid response but wants a short tech review before tomorrow's demo. Sending remediation summary now and scheduling the review in the morning.
Luis (AM): Noted. I'll include the remediation summary + credit details in the renewal brief and reach out in 3 days. If demo goes well, prioritize a cross-sell motion.
Priya (Support): Leaving ticket open for follow-up items. I'll attach logs from the failed ingest run and the CI job timeline.
Sam (CS): Internal comms snippet for CRM: "Helio Labs trial experienced 504 gateway timeouts on bulk ingest due to edge-cache eviction under concurrent writes. Temporary routing + concurrency cap mitigated the issue during customer validation. Actions: $750 credit + 1-week trial extension offered; SSO & ingest scripts delivered; eng fix queued (debounce PR + rate-limiter). Renewal flagged for proactive contact in 3 days. Contacts: Sam (CS), Luis (AM)."
OpsBot: #INC-2033-900 status=monitoring; last_update=1757777822.
